ILN-YOLOv8 is explicitly a recognition model; connector context is separated by Model and must not be spliced into an invented task span.
Both optimized network and fuzzy PID are explicit control methods for power-point tracking; all four scoped pairs are covered.
Personality prediction is explicitly performed by MBTI classification with the attention network; MBTI is a task typology, not a benchmark.
The LLM family is clear, but generic NLP Models lacks a specific technique identity; keep that scope uncertainty outside training.
The named CryoTransformer and separate lowercase transformer explicitly perform particle picking; micrographs supply modality rather than a dataset name.
Sampling schemes remain unspecified and indirect to retrieval; retain that uncertainty instead of inventing active-learning selection methods or a literature corpus.

Using explicitly links learning to identifying the specified electrograms in ablation; no clinical dataset or treatment conclusion follows.
Both mathematical procedures explicitly solve reaction-diffusion equations; label their written roles without misrepresenting the diffusion as a generative AI model.
By explicitly supplies regression and deep learning for building energy-cost modeling; building sector is context, not a named benchmark.
The subtitle explicitly supplies a deep-learning evaluation approach; force-directed layouts are inspected objects within the maximal readability task.
Multi-magnification specifies the network mechanism, while multi-class specifies segmentation outputs; no resource or experimental accuracy is supplied.
Electronic triage is a written operation; patient-priority systems may be software rather than a task and must remain unresolved.
Federated learning is the explicit family; combining it with an IoT field is not a defined feature-fusion task or dataset.
For directly assigns learning to unlicensed-LTE hidden-node detection; LTE names the application setting.
The cognitive-ability title admits behavioral rather than algorithmic learning; retain the unresolved method role and do not invent a cognitive prediction task.
UMAP explicitly performs augmentation, while the composite wind predictor receives its benefit; the latter reverse instrument assertion is title-scoped negative.
PAC reinforcement learning identifies a family; polynomial-time guarantee and rich observations do not name an independent task or benchmark.
Knowledge-based may qualify the explanation rather than transfer learning; the initial complete composite boundary is too certain.
